sections.theory:
1. Cooking

Often people are careless while cooking food and put things that catch fire, e.g. cloth, oil or other things, near the stove and go out of the kitchen, through which the danger of fire increases.

Fire appliances

In homes different appliances of fire are used. Among these appliances heaters, stoves, chimneys, gas cylinders etc. are included. These appliances should be checked by an expert technician at least once a year. Burnable things should be kept at a distance of one metre from these appliances, for example clothes, paper, books, curtains, furniture etc. Take care while drying clothes and shoes on the heater. Install fire alarms in homes and schools so that information is received in time.

Cigarette smoking

Some people smoke cigarettes carelessly. They throw cigarettes near burnable things and do not pay attention. From this the remaining things catch fire.

Electrical appliances

A big cause of fire in homes is the use of defective electrical appliances and wires, from which often a short circuit happens and fire breaks out.
